question: How many paying subscribers do we have right now, split by plan?
gold_sql: SELECT plan_code, COUNT(*) AS paying_subscribers FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber_account WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY plan_code ORDER BY plan_code

question: What was the churn rate for the Premium plan in August?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(churned_flag), 4) AS churn_rate FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber_account WHERE plan_code = 'Premium' AND churn_month = '2026-08'

question: How many payment attempts failed in October, and what share of all attempts was that?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_attempts, COUNT(*) AS all_attempts, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) AS failed_share FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_billing.payment_attempt WHERE attempted_at >= '2026-10-01' AND attempted_at < '2026-11-01'

question: Which plan has the highest average revenue per paying subscriber?
gold_sql: SELECT plan_code, ROUND(AVG(arpu_usd), 2) AS avg_revenue_usd FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber_account WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY plan_code ORDER BY avg_revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which five titles had the most watch hours last week?
gold_sql: SELECT t.title_name, ROUND(SUM(v.watch_seconds) / 3600, 0) AS watch_hours FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.viewing_session v JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title t ON v.title_id = t.title_id WHERE v.session_date >= '2026-11-02' AND v.session_date < '2026-11-09' GROUP BY t.title_name ORDER BY watch_hours DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many episodes of Dungeon Cafe were watched in Brazil in September?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.episode_id) AS episodes_watched FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.viewing_session v JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title t ON v.title_id = t.title_id WHERE t.title_name = 'Dungeon Cafe' AND v.country_code = 'BR' AND v.session_date >= '2026-09-01' AND v.session_date < '2026-10-01'

question: What share of viewing came from mobile devices last month?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN v.device_type = 'mobile' THEN v.watch_seconds ELSE 0 END) / SUM(v.watch_seconds), 3) AS mobile_share FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.viewing_session v WHERE v.session_date >= '2026-10-01' AND v.session_date < '2026-11-01'

question: Which simulcast titles had the lowest completion rate this season?
gold_sql: SELECT t.title_name, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN v.completed THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 3) AS completion_rate FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.viewing_session v JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title t ON v.title_id = t.title_id WHERE t.simulcast = true AND t.season_code = '2026-fall' GROUP BY t.title_name ORDER BY completion_rate ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which sales region closed the most licensing deals this year?
gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS deals_closed FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.licensing_deal WHERE signed_date >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY region ORDER BY deals_closed DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many territory windows expire in the next 90 days for titles licensed in France?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS expiring_windows FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory_window w JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement l ON w.license_id = l.license_id WHERE l.territory_code = 'FR' AND w.window_end >= '2026-11-11' AND w.window_end < '2027-02-09'

question: Which partner accounts sent the most device activations this quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT p.partner_name, COUNT(*) AS activations FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.device_activation a JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner_account p ON a.partner_id = p.partner_id WHERE a.activated_on >= '2026-10-01' GROUP BY p.partner_name ORDER BY activations DESC LIMIT 3

question: What did we pay in licence fees for Dungeon Cafe, by territory?
gold_sql: SELECT l.territory_code, SUM(l.fee_usd) AS fees_usd FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement l JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title t ON l.title_id = t.title_id WHERE t.title_name = 'Dungeon Cafe' GROUP BY l.territory_code ORDER BY fees_usd DESC

question: Which of those territories has the longest remaining window?
gold_sql: SELECT w.territory_code, MAX(w.window_end) AS window_end FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory_window w JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement l ON w.license_id = l.license_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title t ON l.title_id = t.title_id WHERE t.title_name = 'Dungeon Cafe' GROUP BY w.territory_code ORDER BY window_end DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which studio had the most licence agreements ending in 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT l.licensor_name, COUNT(*) AS expiring FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement l WHERE YEAR(l.end_date) = 2026 GROUP BY l.licensor_name ORDER BY expiring DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many Premium subscribers watched a title whose Japanese licence ends this year?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.account_id) AS subscribers FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber_account s JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.viewing_session v ON s.account_id = v.account_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement l ON v.title_id = l.title_id WHERE s.plan_code = 'Premium' AND l.territory_code = 'JP' AND YEAR(l.end_date) = 2026

question: Compare licence fees with watch hours last week for the three most-watched titles.
gold_sql: WITH hours AS (SELECT title_id, SUM(watch_seconds) / 3600 AS watch_hours FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.viewing_session WHERE session_date >= '2026-11-02' AND session_date < '2026-11-09' GROUP BY title_id) SELECT t.title_name, ROUND(SUM(l.fee_usd), 0) AS licence_fees_usd, ROUND(h.watch_hours, 0) AS watch_hours FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title t JOIN hours h ON t.title_id = h.title_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement l ON t.title_id = l.title_id GROUP BY t.title_name, h.watch_hours ORDER BY h.watch_hours DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which signed licensing deals were in regions where we added more than 100,000 subscribers last quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT d.region, COUNT(*) AS deals, SUM(d.value_usd) AS deal_value_usd FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.licensing_deal d WHERE d.signed_date >= '2026-07-01' AND d.signed_date < '2026-10-01' AND d.region IN (SELECT region FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber_account WHERE created_at >= '2026-07-01' AND created_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY region HAVING COUNT(*) > 100000) GROUP BY d.region ORDER BY deal_value_usd DESC
